dn3:1.1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
dn3:1.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
dn3:1.2.1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ukkaṭṭhaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
dn3:1.2.3: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
dn3:1.2.4: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn3:1.2.5: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
dn3:1.2.6: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn3:1.2.7: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn3:1.2.8: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
dn3:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa ambaṭṭho nāma māṇavo antevāsī hoti ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo anuññātapaṭiññāto sake ācariyake tevijjake pāvacane
dn3:1.4.1: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
dn3:1.4.2: “ayaṃ tāta ambaṭṭha samaṇo gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
dn3:1.4.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn3:1.4.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
dn3:1.4.8: ehi tvaṃ tāta ambaṭṭha, yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ jānāhi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā,
dn3:1.4.9: yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso, yadi vā na tādiso, tathā mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vedissāmāti.
dn3:1.5.1: “yathā kathaṃ panāhaṃ bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ jānissāmi yadi vā taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathāsantaṃyeva saddo abbhuggato, yadi vā no tathā, yadi vā so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso yadi vā na tādiso”ti.
dn3:1.5.2: “āgatāni kho tāta ambaṭṭha, amhākaṃ mantesu dvattiṃsa mahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa mahāpurisassa dveva gatiyo bhavanti anaññā:
dn3:1.5.3: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
dn3:1.5.5: seyyathidaṃ: cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, parināyakaratanameva sattamaṃ.
dn3:1.5.6: parosahassaṃ kho panassa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn3:1.5.7: so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn3:1.5.8: sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti sammāsambuddho loke vivattacchado.
dn3:1.5.9: ahaṃ kho pana tāta ambaṭṭha mantānaṃ dātā
dn3:1.6.1: “evaṃ bho’ti kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasātiṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā vaḷavārathamāruyha sambahulehi māṇavehi saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tena pāyāsi.
dn3:1.6.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko’va ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
dn3:1.7.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū abbhokāse caṅkamanti.
dn3:1.7.2: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
dn3:1.7.3: “kahannu kho bho etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati?
dn3:1.7.4: taṃ hi mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya idhūpasaṅkantā”ti.
dn3:1.8.2: “ayaṃ kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo abhiññātakolañño ceva abhiññātassa ca brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa antevāsī.
dn3:1.8.3: agaru kho pana bhagavato evarūpehi kulaputtehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hotī”ti.
dn3:1.8.5: “eso ambaṭṭha vihāro saṃvutadvāro. tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭehi. vivarissati te bhagavā dvāranti.”
dn3:1.9.1: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena so vihāro saṃvutadvāro tena appasaddo upasaṅkamitvā ataramāno ālindaṃ pavisitvā ukkāsitvā aggaḷaṃ ākoṭesi. vivari bhagavā dvāraṃ.
dn3:1.9.2: pāvisi ambaṭṭho māṇavo. māṇavakā’pi pavisitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
dn3:1.9.3: ambaṭṭho pana māṇavo caṅkamanto’pi nisinnena bhagavatā kañci kañci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāreti. ṭhito’pi nisinnena bhagavatā kañci kañci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāreti.
dn3:1.9.4: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.9.5: evannu kho te ambaṭṭha, brāhmaṇehi vuddhehi mahallakehi ācariyapācariyehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo hoti yathayidaṃ caraṃ tiṭṭhaṃ nisinnena mayā kañci kañci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretī?”ti
dn3:1.10.2: gacchanto vā hi bho gotama gacchantena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati. ṭhito vā hi bho gotama ṭhitena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati. nisinno vā hi bho gotama nisinnena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati. sayāno vā hi bho gotama sayānena brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ sallapitumarahati.
dn3:1.10.3: ye ca kho te bho gotama muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādāpaccā, tehipi me saddhiṃ evaṃ kathāsallāpo hoti yathariva bhotā gotamenā”ti.
dn3:1.11.1: “atthikavato kho pana te ambaṭṭha idhāgamanaṃ ahosi. yāyeva kho panatthāya āgaccheyyātho tameva atthaṃ sādhukaṃ manasi kareyyātho. avusitavā
dn3:1.11.2: yeva kho pana bho ayaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo vusitamānī kimaññatra avusitattā”ti.
dn3:1.12.1: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavatā avusitavādena vuccamāno kupito anattamano bhagavantaṃyeva khuṃsento bhagavantaṃyeva vambhento bhagavantaṃyeva upavadamāno
dn3:1.12.2: samaṇo ca me bho gotamo pāpito bhavissatīti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.12.7: ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyanti.
dn3:1.12.8: tayidaṃ bho gotama nacchannaṃ tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yadime sakyā ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyantīti.
dn3:1.12.9: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ paṭhamaṃ sakkesu ibbhavādaṃ nipātesi. “kimpana
dn3:1.13.2: “eka midāhaṃ bho gotama, samayaṃ ācariyassa brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa kenacideva karaṇīyena kapilavatthuṃ agamāsiṃ.
dn3:1.13.4: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā sakyā ceva sakyakumārā ca santhāgāre uccesu āsanesu nisinnā honti aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghantā saṃkīḷantā aññadatthu mamaññeva maññe anujagghantā. na maṃ koci āsanena’pi nimantesi.
dn3:1.13.5: tayidaṃ bho gotama nacchannaṃ, tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ, yadime sakyā ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyantī”ti.
dn3:1.13.6: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ dutiyaṃ sakkesu ibbhavādaṃ nipātesi.
dn3:1.14.1: “laṭukikāpi kho ambaṭṭha, sakuṇikā sake kulāvake kāmalāpinī hoti.
dn3:1.14.2: sakaṃ kho panetaṃ ambaṭṭha sakyānaṃ yadidaṃ kapilavatthu. na arahatāyasmā ambaṭṭho imāya appamattāya abhisajjitunti.”
dn3:1.14.5: imesaṃ hi bho gotama catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ tayo vaṇṇā
dn3:1.14.6: khattiyā ca vessā ca suddā ca
dn3:1.14.8: tayidaṃ bho gotama nacchannaṃ tayidaṃ nappaṭirūpaṃ yadi me sakyā ibbhā santā ibbhā samānā na brāhmaṇe sakkaronti na brāhmaṇe garukaronti na brāhmaṇe mānenti na brāhmaṇe pūjenti na brāhmaṇe apacāyantī”ti.
dn3:1.14.9: itiha ambaṭṭho māṇavo idaṃ tatiyaṃ sakkesu ibbhavādaṃ nipātesi.
dn3:1.15.2: atibāḷhaṃ kho ayaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo sakkesu ibbhavādena nimmāneti. yannūnāhaṃ gottaṃ puccheyyanti.
dn3:1.15.3: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.15.6: “porāṇaṃ kho pana te ambaṭṭha mātāpettikaṃ nāmagottaṃ anussarato ayyaputtā sakyā bhavanti, dāsiputto tvamasi sakyānaṃ.
dn3:1.15.7: sakyā kho pana ambaṭṭha, rājānaṃ okkākaṃ pitāmahaṃ dahanti.
dn3:1.15.8: “bhūtapubbaṃ ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mahesī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetukāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi
dn3:1.15.10: te raṭṭhasmā pabbājitā himavantapasse pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahāsākasaṇḍo tattha vāsaṃ kappesuṃ.
dn3:1.15.11: te jātisambhedabhayā sakāhi bhaginīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappesuṃ.
dn3:1.15.12: atha kho ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko amacce pārisajje āmantesi:
dn3:1.15.14: “atthi deva, himavantapasse pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahāsākasaṇḍo tatthetarahi kumārā sammanti.
dn3:1.15.15: te jātisambhedabhayā sakāhi bhaginīhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappentī”ti.
dn3:1.15.16: atha kho ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko udānaṃ udānesi:
dn3:1.15.17: “sakyā vata bho kumārā paramasakyā vata bho kumārā”ti.
dn3:1.15.18: tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha, sakyā paññāyanti. so’va nesaṃ pubbapuriso.
dn3:1.16.1: rañño ca kho pana ambaṭṭha, okkākassa disā nāma dāsī ahosi.
dn3:1.16.4: “dhovatha maṃ amma, nahāpetha maṃ amma, imasmā maṃ amma asucismā parimocetha, atthāya vo bhavissāmī’ti.
dn3:1.16.5: yathā kho pana ambaṭṭha, etarahi manussā pisāce disvā ‘pisācā’ti sañjānanti.
dn3:1.16.6: evameva kho ambaṭṭha, tena samayena manussā pisāce ‘kaṇhā’ti sañjānanti.
dn3:1.16.8: ayaṃ jāto pabyāhāsi: ‘kaṇho jāto, pisāco jāto’ti.
dn3:1.16.9: tadagge kho pana ambaṭṭha, kaṇhāyanā paññāyanti. so ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapuriso.
dn3:1.16.10: iti kho te ambaṭṭha, porāṇaṃ mātāpettikaṃ nāmagottaṃ anussarato ayyaputtā sakyā bhavanti. dāsiputto tvamasi sakyānanti.
dn3:1.17.1: evaṃ vutte te māṇavakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn3:1.17.2: “mā bhavaṃ gotamo ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmānesi.
dn3:1.17.3: sujāto ca bho gotama, ambaṭṭho māṇavo kulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bahussuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo paṇḍito ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo. pahoti ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetu”nti.
dn3:1.18.1: atha kho bhagavā te māṇavake etadavoca:
dn3:1.18.3: ‘dujjāto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, akulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, appassuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, akalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, duppañño ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, na ca pahoti ambaṭṭho māṇavo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetunti, tiṭṭhatu ambaṭṭho māṇavo, tumhe mayā saddhiṃ mantayavho asmiṃ vacane.
dn3:1.18.4: sace pana tumhākaṃ māṇavakā evaṃ hoti:
dn3:1.18.5: sujāto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, kulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, bahussuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, paṇḍito ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, pahoti ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetunti, tiṭṭhatha tumhe,
dn3:1.19.1: “sujāto ca bho gotama ambaṭṭho māṇavo, kulaputto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, bahussuto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, paṇḍito ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo, pahoti ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetuṃ. tuṇhī mayaṃ bhavissāma. ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetū”ti.
dn3:1.20.1: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.20.2: ayaṃ kho pana te ambaṭṭha, sahadhammiko pañho āgacchati. akāmāpi vyākātabbo.
dn3:1.20.3: sace tvaṃ na vyākarissasi aññena vā aññaṃ paṭicarissasi, tuṇhī vā bhavissasi, pakkamissasi vā ettheva te sattadhā muddhā phalissati.
dn3:1.20.5: kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ kutopabhutikā kaṇhāyanā? ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapuriso?ti
dn3:1.20.6: evaṃ vutte ambaṭṭho māṇavo tuṇhī ahosi.
dn3:1.20.7: dutiyampi kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.20.8: taṃ kimmaññasi ambaṭṭha? kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ …pe… ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapuriso?ti
dn3:1.20.9: dutiyampi kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo tuṇhī ahosi.
dn3:1.20.10: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.20.11: vyākarohi ‘dāni ambaṭṭha, na’dāni te tuṇhībhāvassa kālo.
dn3:1.20.12: yo kho ambaṭṭha tathāgatena yāvatatiyakaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na vyākaroti etthevassa sattadhā muddhā phalissati.
dn3:1.21.1: tena kho pana samayena vajirapāṇi yakkho mahantaṃ ayokūṭaṃ ādāya ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ ambaṭṭhassa māṇavassa uparivehāsaṃ ṭhito hoti:
dn3:1.21.2: sacāyaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavatā yāvatatiyakaṃ sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho na vyākarissati, etthevassa sattadhā muddhaṃ phālessāmīti.
dn3:1.21.3: taṃ kho pana vajirapāṇiṃ yakkhaṃ bhagavā ceva passati ambaṭṭho ca māṇavo.
dn3:1.21.4: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃyeva tāṇagavesī bhagavantaṃyeva leṇagavesī bhagavantaṃyeva saraṇagavesī upanisīditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:1.21.8: kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ, kutoppabhutikā kaṇhāyanā? ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapuriso?ti.”
dn3:1.21.9: “evameva me bho gotama sutaṃ, yatheva bhavaṃ gotamo āha.
dn3:1.22.1: evaṃ vutte te māṇavakā unnādino uccāsaddamahāsaddā ahesuṃ:
dn3:1.22.2: “dujjāto kira bho ambaṭṭho māṇavo, akulaputto kira bho ambaṭṭho māṇavo, dāsiputto kira bho ambaṭṭho māṇavo sakyānaṃ, ayyaputtā kira bho ambaṭṭhassa māṇavassa sakyā bhavanti.
dn3:1.22.3: dhammavādiṃ yeva kira mayaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ apasādetabbaṃ amaññimhā”ti.
dn3:1.23.2: “atibāḷhaṃ kho ime māṇavakā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmānenti. yannūnāhaṃ parimoceyyanti.”
dn3:1.23.3: atha kho bhagavā te māṇavake etadavoca:
dn3:1.23.4: “mā kho tumhe māṇavakā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmānetha.
dn3:1.23.6: so dakkhiṇaṃ janapadaṃ gantvā brahme mante adhīyitvā rājānaṃ okkākaṃ upasaṅkamitvā maṭṭharūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yāci.
dn3:1.23.8: ‘ko neva re ayaṃ mayhaṃ dāsiputto samāno maṭṭharūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yācatī’ti kupito anattamano khurappaṃ sannayhi.
dn3:1.23.9: so taṃ khurappaṃ neva asakkhi muñcituṃ, no paṭisaṃharituṃ.
dn3:1.23.10: atha kho māṇavakā amaccā pārisajjā kaṇhaṃ isiṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ:
dn3:1.23.13: “sotthi bhavissati rañño, api ca rājā yadi adho khurappaṃ muñcissati yāvatā rañño vijitaṃ ettāvatā paṭhavī udrīyissatī”ti.
dn3:1.23.15: “sotthi bhavissati rañño, sotthi janapadassa. api ca rājā yadi uddhaṃ khurappaṃ muñcissati yāvatā rañño vijitaṃ ettāvatā sattavassāni devo na vassissatī”ti.
dn3:1.23.16: “sotthi bhadante hotu rañño, sotthi janapadassa, devo ca vassatū”ti.
dn3:1.23.17: “sotthi bhavissati rañño, sotthi janapadassa, devo ca vassissati. api ca rājā jeṭṭhakumāre khurappaṃ patiṭṭhāpetu, sotthi kumāro, pallomo bhavissatī”ti.
dn3:1.23.18: atha kho māṇavakā, amaccā okkākassa ārocesuṃ:
dn3:1.23.19: “devo jeṭṭhakumāre khurappaṃ patiṭṭhāpetu, sotthi kumāro pallomo bhavissatī”ti.
dn3:1.23.20: atha kho rājā okkāko jeṭṭhakumāre khurappaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi. sotthi kumāro pallomo bhavi.
dn3:1.23.21: atha kho tassa rājā okkāko bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto brahmadaṇḍena tajjito maṭṭharūpiṃ dhītaraṃ adāsi.
dn3:1.23.22: mā kho tumhe māṇavakā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ atibāḷhaṃ dāsiputtavādena nimmānetha. uḷāro so kaṇho isi ahosi.
dn3:1.24.1: atha kho bhagavā ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
dn3:1.24.3: idha khattiyakumāro brāhmaṇakaññāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya, tesaṃ saṃvāsamanvāya putto jāyetha,
dn3:1.24.4: yo so khattiyakumārena brāhmaṇakaññāya putto uppanno, api nu so labhetha brāhmaṇesu āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā?’ti,
dn3:1.24.6: “api nu naṃ brāhmaṇā bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā?”ti
dn3:1.24.8: “api nu naṃ brāhmaṇā mante vāceyyuṃ vā no vā?”ti
dn3:1.24.10: “apinu’ssa itthīsu āvaṭaṃ vā assa anāvaṭaṃ vā?”ti
dn3:1.25.2: idha brāhmaṇakumāro khattiyakaññāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya, tesaṃ saṃvāsamanvāya putto jāyetha,
dn3:1.25.3: yo so brāhmaṇakumārena khattiyakaññāya putto uppanno, api nu so labhetha brāhmaṇesu āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā?”ti

dn3:1.26.1: “iti kho ambaṭṭha, itthiyā vā itthiṃ karitvā purisena vā purisaṃ karitvā khattiyā ‘va seṭṭhā, hīnā brāhmaṇā.
dn3:1.26.3: idha brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ kismicideva pakaraṇe khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā assapuṭena vadhitvā raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pabbājeyyuṃ,
dn3:1.26.4: api nu so labhetha brāhmaṇesu āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā?”ti
dn3:1.26.6: “api nu naṃ brāhmaṇā bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā?”ti.
dn3:1.26.8: “api nu naṃ brāhmaṇā mante vāceyyuṃ vā no vā”ti.
dn3:1.26.10: “api nu’ssa itthīsu āvaṭaṃ vā assa anāvaṭaṃ vā?ti”
dn3:1.27.2: idha khattiyā khattiyaṃ kismiñcideva pakaraṇe khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā assapuṭena vadhitvā raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pabbājeyyuṃ,
dn3:1.27.3: api nu so labhetha brāhmaṇesu āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā?ti”
dn3:1.27.5: “api nu naṃ brāhmaṇā bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā?ti”

dn3:1.27.9: “api nu’ssa itthīsu āvaṭaṃ vā assa anāvaṭaṃ vā?”ti
dn3:1.27.11: “ettāvatā kho ambaṭṭha, khattiyo paramanihīnataṃ patto hoti, yadeva naṃ khattiyā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā assapuṭena vadhitvā raṭṭhā vā nagarā vā pabbājenti.
dn3:1.27.12: iti kho ambaṭṭha yadā khattiyo paramanihīnataṃ patto hoti, tadāpi khattiyā’va seṭṭhā hīnā brāhmaṇā.
dn3:1.28.6: sā kho panesā ambaṭṭha, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā mayā.
dn3:2.1.1: “katamaṃ pana taṃ bho gotama caraṇaṃ, katamā ca pana sā vijjā?”ti.
dn3:2.1.2: “na kho ambaṭṭha, anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya jātivādo vā vuccati, gottavādo vā vuccati, mānavādo vā vuccati:
dn3:2.1.3: ‘arahasi vā maṃ tvaṃ na vā maṃ tvaṃ arahasī’ti.
dn3:2.1.4: yattha kho ambaṭṭha āvāho vā hoti, vivāho vā hoti, āvāhavivāho vā hoti, etthetaṃ vuccati jātivādo vā itipi, gottavādo vā itipi, mānavādo vā itipi:
dn3:2.1.5: ‘arahasi vā maṃ tvaṃ na vā maṃ tvaṃ arahasī’ti.
dn3:2.1.6: ye hi keci ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhā vā gottavādavinibaddhā vā mānavādavinibaddhā vā āvāhavivāhavinibaddhā vā, ārakā te anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya.
dn3:2.1.7: pahāya kho ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhañca gottavādavinibaddhañca mānavādavinibaddhañca āvāhavivāhavinibaddhañca anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya sacchikiriyā hotī”ti.
dn3:2.2.1: “katamaṃ pana taṃ bho gotama caraṇaṃ? katamā ca sā vijjā?”ti.
dn3:2.2.2: “idha ambaṭṭha, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
dn3:2.2.3: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn3:2.2.4: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn3:2.2.5: taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto.
dn3:2.2.6: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
dn3:2.2.7: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisaṃcikkhati: “sambādho gharāvāso rajopatho abbhokāso pabbajjā. nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṃkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ, yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti. so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati. so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī. samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu kāyakammavacīkammena samannāgato kusalena, parisuddhājīvo sīlasampanno indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū satisampajaññena samannāgato santuṭṭho. kathañca ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti? idha ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati. idampi’ssa hoti sīlasmiṃ. adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti. dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā dn3:2.2.8: so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. seyyathāpi ambaṭṭha, dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya, sāyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena, na ca pagghariṇī, evameva kho ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn3:2.2.10: puna caparaṃ ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. seyyathāpi ambaṭṭha, udakarahado gambhīro ubbhidodako, tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ, devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya, atha kho tamhā ca udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisanneyya parisanneyya paripūreyya paripphareyya, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa, evameva kho ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn3:2.2.12: puna caparaṃ ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno, sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. seyyathāpi ambaṭṭha, uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni cā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni tāni yāva caggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphuṭāni nāssa kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphuṭaṃ assa. evameva kho ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn3:2.2.14: puna caparaṃ ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti. seyyathāpi ambaṭṭha, puriso odātena vatthena sasīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa, nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphuṭaṃ assa, evameva kho ambaṭṭha bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn3:2.2.16: idaṃ kho taṃ ambaṭṭha caraṇaṃ. [puna caparaṃ ambaṭṭha]
dn3:2.2.17: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so evaṃ pajānāti: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo. idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhanti. seyyathāpi ambaṭṭha, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno, tatrassa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā. tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya: ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno anāvilo sabbākārasampanno. tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā’ti. evameva kho ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so evaṃ pajānāti: ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo. idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhanti.
dn3:2.2.18: idampi’ssa hoti vijjāya. so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati dn3:2.4.15: api nu tvaṃ imañceva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhuṇamāno pavattaphalabhojanatañca anabhisambhuṇamāno kandamūlaphalabhojanatañca anabhisambhuṇamāno gāmasāmantaṃ vā nigamasāmantaṃ vā agyāgāraṃ karitvā aggiṃ paricaranto acchasi sācariyako?”ti
dn3:2.4.18: api nu tvaṃ imañceva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhuṇamāno pavattaphalabhojanatañca anabhisambhuṇamāno kandamūlaphalabhojanatañca anabhisambhuṇamāno aggiparicariyañca anabhisambhuṇamāno cātummahāpathe catudvāraṃ agāraṃ karitvā acchasi sācariyako,
dn3:2.4.19: yo imāhi catūhi disāhi āgamissati samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā taṃ mayaṃ yathāsatti yathābalaṃ paṭipūjessāmāti?”
dn3:2.5.1: iti kho ambaṭṭha, imāya ce va tvaṃ anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya parihīno sācariyako.
dn3:2.5.2: ye cime anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya cattāri apāyamukhāni bhavanti, tato ca tvaṃ parihīno sācariyako.
dn3:2.5.3: bhāsitā kho pana te esā ambaṭṭha, ācariyena brāhmaṇena pokkharasādinā vācā
dn3:2.5.4: “ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādāpaccā, kā ca tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ sākacchā”ti, attanā āpāyiko’pi aparipūrayamāno.
dn3:2.5.5: passa ambaṭṭha, yāva aparaddhañca te idaṃ ācariyassa brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa.
dn3:2.6.1: brāhmaṇo kho pana ambaṭṭha, pokkharasādī rañño pasenadissa kosalassa dattikaṃ bhuñjati.
dn3:2.6.2: tassa rājā pasenadī kosalo sammukhībhāvampi na dadāti.
dn3:2.6.4: yassa kho pana ambaṭṭha, dhammikaṃ payataṃ bhikkhaṃ patigaṇheyya, kathaṃ tassa rājā pasenadī kosalo sammukhībhāvampi na dadeyya?
dn3:2.6.5: passa ambaṭṭha, yāva aparaddhañca te idaṃ ācariyassa brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa.
dn3:2.7.2: rājā pasenadī kosalo hatthigīvāya vā nisinno assapiṭṭhe vā nisinno rathūpatthare vā ṭhito uggehi vā rājaññehi vā kiñcideva mantaṇaṃ manteyya,
dn3:2.7.3: so tamhā padesā apakkamma ekamantaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
dn3:2.7.4: atha āgaccheyya suddo vā suddadāso vā, so tasmiṃ padese ṭhito tadeva mantaṇaṃ manteyya:
dn3:2.7.5: evampi rājā pasenadī kosalo āha evampi rājā pasenadī kosalo āhāti.
dn3:2.7.6: api nu so rājabhaṇitaṃ vā bhaṇati rājamantanaṃ vā manteti,
dn3:2.7.7: ettāvatā so assa rājā vā rājamahāmatto vāti?”
dn3:2.8.1: evameva kho tvaṃ ambaṭṭha, ye te ahesuṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samūhitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti, seyyathidaṃ: aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu,
dn3:2.8.2: tyāhaṃ mante adhiyāmi sācariyako’ti tāvatā tvaṃ bhavissasi isi vā isittāya vā paṭipanno’ti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn3:2.9.2: kinti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn3:2.9.3: “ye te ahesuṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samūhitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti bhāsitamanubhāsanti vācitamanuvācenti seyyathidaṃ: aṭṭako, vāmako, vāmadevo, vessāmitto, yamataggi, aṅgīraso, bhāradvājo, vāseṭṭho, kassapo, bhagu -
dn3:2.9.4: evaṃ su te sunhātā suvilittā kappitakesamassū āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalābharaṇā odātavatthavasanā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricārenti, seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyako?” ti.
dn3:2.10.2: “evaṃ su te sālīnaṃ odanaṃ sucimaṃsūpasecanaṃ vicitakālakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ paribhuñjanti, seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyako?”ti.
dn3:2.10.5: “evaṃ su te veṭhanakapassāhi nārīhi paricārenti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyako?”ti.
dn3:2.10.8: “evaṃ su te kuttavālehi vaḷavārathehi dīghāhi patodalaṭṭhīhi vāhane vitudentā vipariyāyanti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyako?”ti.
dn3:2.10.11: “evaṃ su te ukkiṇṇaparikhāsu okkhittapalighāsu nagarūpakārikāsu dīghāsibaddhehi purisehi rakkhāpeti seyyathāpi tvaṃ etarahi sācariyako?”ti.
dn3:2.10.13: “iti kho ambaṭṭha, neva tvaṃ isi, na isittāya paṭipanno sācariyako.
dn3:2.10.14: yassa kho pana ambaṭṭha mayi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā, so maṃ pañhena, ahaṃ veyyākaraṇena sodhissāmī”ti.
dn3:2.11.1: atha kho bhagavā vihārā nikkhamma caṅkamaṃ abbhuṭṭhāsi.
dn3:2.11.2: ambaṭṭho’pi māṇavo vihārā nikkhamma caṅkamaṃ abbhuṭṭhāsi.
dn3:2.11.3: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavantaṃ caṅkamantaṃ anucaṅkamamāno kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi.
dn3:2.11.4: addasa kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
dn3:2.11.5: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.12.2: passati kho me ayaṃ ambaṭṭho māṇavo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
dn3:2.12.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.12.5: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
dn3:2.12.6: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho’pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi parimasi. ubho’pi nāsikāsotāni anumasi parimasi. kevalampi naḷāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
dn3:2.12.8: samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehīti
dn3:2.12.10: “handa ca’dāni mayaṃ bho gotama gacchāma. bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā”ti.
dn3:2.12.12: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo vaḷavārathamāruyha pakkāmi.
dn3:2.13.1: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī ukkaṭṭhāya nikkhamitvā mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ sake ārāme nisinno hoti ambaṭṭhaṃ yeva māṇavaṃ paṭimānento.
dn3:2.13.2: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yena sako ārāmo tena pāyāsi.
dn3:2.14.1: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi, yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattiko’va yena brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasādiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī etadavoca:
dn3:2.14.2: kacci tāta ambaṭṭha addasa taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamanti?
dn3:2.14.3: “addasāma kho mayaṃ bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamanti.”
dn3:2.14.4: “kacci tāta ambaṭṭha taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ tathā santo yeva saddo abbhuggato no aññathā?
dn3:2.14.5: kacci pana bho so bhavaṃ gotamo tādiso no aññādiso?”ti.
dn3:2.14.6: “tathā santo yeva bho taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saddo abbhuggato no aññathā, tādiso’va bho so bhavaṃ gotamo no aññādiso.
dn3:2.14.7: samannāgato ca bho so bhavaṃ gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehī”ti.
dn3:2.14.8: “ahu pana te tāta ambaṭṭha, samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpo?”ti.
dn3:2.14.9: “ahu kho yeva bho, samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpo?”ti.
dn3:2.14.10: “yathākathaṃ pana te tāta ambaṭṭha, ahu samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpo?”ti.
dn3:2.14.11: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo yāvatako ahosi bhagavatā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa ārocesi.
dn3:2.15.1: evaṃ vutte brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:2.15.2: “aho vata re, amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka! aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka! aho vata re, amhākaṃ tevijjaka! evarūpena kira bho puriso atthacarakena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya.
dn3:2.15.3: yadeva kho tvaṃ ambaṭṭha taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ āsajja āsajja avacāsi. atha kho so bhavaṃ gotamo amhe’pi evaṃ upaneyya upaneyya avaca.
dn3:2.15.4: aho vata re, amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka! aho vata re, amhākaṃ bahussutaka! aho vata re, amhākaṃ tevijjaka! evarūpena kira bho puriso atthacarakena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā”ti kupito anattamano ambaṭṭhaṃ māṇavaṃ padasā yeva pavattesi.
dn3:2.15.5: icchati ca tāvadeva bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
dn3:2.16.1: atha kho te brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasādiṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn3:2.16.2: ativikālo kho bho ajja samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
dn3:2.16.3: svedāni bhavaṃ pokkharasātī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī”ti.
dn3:2.16.4: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā yānesu āropetvā ukkāsu dhāriyamānāsu ukkaṭṭhāya niyyāsi. yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tena pāyāsi.
dn3:2.17.1: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā, yānā paccorohitvā pattiko’va yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:2.17.2: “āgamānukhavidha bho gotama, amhākaṃ antevāsī ambaṭṭho māṇavo?”ti.
dn3:2.17.3: “āgamā kho te brāhmaṇa, antevāsī ambaṭṭho māṇavo”ti.
dn3:2.17.4: “ahu pana te bho gotama, ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpo?”ti.
dn3:2.17.5: “ahu kho me brāhmaṇa, ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpo”ti.
dn3:2.17.6: “yathākathaṃ pana te bho gotama, ahu ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kocideva kathāsallāpo?”ti.
dn3:2.17.7: atha kho bhagavā yāvatiko ahosi ambaṭṭhena māṇavena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa ārocesi.
dn3:2.17.9: bālo bho gotama, ambaṭṭho māṇavo. khamatu bhavaṃ gotamo ambaṭṭhassa māṇavassā”ti.
dn3:2.18.1: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni samannesi.
dn3:2.18.2: addasā kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī bhagavato kāye dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
dn3:2.18.3: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.18.6: passati kho me ayaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇāni yebhuyyena ṭhapetvā dve.
dn3:2.18.7: dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati
dn3:2.18.9: atha kho bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā addasa brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī bhagavato kosohitaṃ vatthaguyhaṃ.
dn3:2.18.10: atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho’pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi, paṭimasi, ubho’pi nāsikāsotāni anumasi, paṭimasi. kevalampi naḷāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
dn3:2.19.2: “samannāgato kho samaṇo gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi paripuṇṇehi no aparipuṇṇehī”ti
dn3:2.19.4: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā”ti.
dn3:2.20.1: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā’ bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi:
dn3:2.20.3: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa parivesanā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn3:2.20.4: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasātī bhagavantaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi. māṇavakā’pi bhikkhusaṅghaṃ.
dn3:2.20.5: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasātī bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn3:2.21.1: ekamantaṃ nisinnassa kho brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa bhagavā ānupubbikathaṃ kathesi, seyyathidaṃ:
dn3:2.21.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ca ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn3:2.21.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi brāhmaṇaṃ pokkharasātiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā taṃ pakāsesi:
dn3:2.21.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya,
dn3:2.21.6: evameva brāhmaṇassa pokkharasādissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
dn3:2.21.7: yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhammanti.
dn3:2.22.1: atha kho brāhmaṇo pokkharasādī diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn3:2.22.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti, evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn3:2.22.4: esāhaṃ bho gotama saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
dn3:2.22.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gataṃ.
dn3:2.22.6: yathā ca bhavaṃ gotamo ukkaṭṭhāya aññāni upāsakakulāni upasaṅkamati evameva bhavaṃ gotamo pokkharasādikulaṃ upasaṅkamatu.
dn3:2.22.7: tattha ye te māṇavakā vā māṇavikā vā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ abhivādessanti vā paccuṭṭhissanti vā āsanaṃ vā udakaṃ vā dassanti cittaṃ vā pasādessanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
